_source: tools/snes_maps.py build (US v1.0 ROM + the PR's vanilla maps). PR (x, y) = SNES (x + dx, y + dy). how: 'chests' = the map's chests pair by contents (port_chests); 'exits' = reached by following exits from such a pair (SNES exit -> the PR GotoMap at the same spot -> its destination and arrival point; the world maps 0 and 1 are seeded as Map_10010 / Map_10020 at (0, 0), so world-map towns are reached through the PR's entrance objects); 'tiles' = only the layouts agree (mutual information between the SNES tile and the PR's tile stack per cell; near-certain, or looser when the PR walks where the SNES walks: walk >= 0.9); 'layout' = an event copy: the SNES map has another placed map's BG1 and BG2 layouts and takes its PR maps. One SNES map is often several PR maps (its rooms, each its own offset) and one layout several SNES maps (World of Balance / Ruin). share / share_pr: the part of each side's tile information the other explains; coverage: the part of the PR map's drawn cells on the SNES layout; entities: SNES exits/NPCs/chests/event tiles on a PR object / on the PR map's cells; walk: [share, cells] of the PR map's walkable cells that are on SNES tiles the SNES tile properties don't make walls (pairs under 0.4 for chests/exits, 0.8 for tiles/layout are dropped)
